title: Which Shell?
lines: Nick has ten shells in a sack.
Nick picks a thick red shell.
When Josh picks it up, it is wet.
A bug is in his shell!
Josh yells and lets it fall.
The bug runs back to the mud.
When Josh picks a shell, Josh checks it.

questions.ask: What is in the shell Josh picks?
questions.listenFor: A bug. It is stated in the story - if they guess, send them back to that line.

questions.ask: Why does Josh let the shell fall?
questions.listenFor: A bug was in it and it was wet. You want cause and effect, not just "he dropped it."

questions.ask: Do you think Josh will pick up more shells? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for a reason from the story, like "yes, but he checks them first now."
